units.function: opens by granting that many readers have the thing others lack

original_instantiations: The opening grants that many readers already have the scarce thing.
The opening grants that many readers already hold the scarce thing.

units.source_excerpt: Although readily available to many of the world's citizens, clean water has become a scarce resource in much of the world
units.reusable_pattern: Open by conceding the reader's privilege with although.
prohibited_generalizations: do not open on the crisis alone

units.function: gives one rich case and one poor case of the same trouble

original_instantiations: One rich case and one poor case carry the same trouble.
One wealthy case and one poor case carry the same trouble.

units.source_excerpt: The increasing frequency of droughts in California and the massive water deficits of large Arab cities such as Dubai
units.reusable_pattern: Pair a rich example with a poor one to show the spread.
prohibited_generalizations: do not give only one kind of example

units.function: cites a dated prediction with its source

original_instantiations: A dated forecast is borrowed with its source named.
A dated forecast is borrowed with its author named.

units.source_excerpt: A study conducted by the United Nations predicted that by 2025, approximately two-thirds of the world's population will be living in water-stressed regions
units.reusable_pattern: Borrow a forecast and name who made it.
prohibited_generalizations: do not give the forecast without its source

units.function: names the quantity and says what it equals

original_instantiations: The quantity is named and then defined.

units.source_excerpt: we termed this water deficit as equal to water consumed per year over the sustainable water resources available
units.reusable_pattern: Coin the term with we termed, then give the ratio.
prohibited_generalizations: do not use the term before defining it

units.function: says why this country and not an obvious one

units.reusable_pattern: Justify the case with because despite.
prohibited_generalizations: do not pick the case without the reason

units.reusable_pattern: Give the present number, then the unchecked future with if.
prohibited_generalizations: do not give the future without the condition

units.function: lists the actions as a numbered series

original_instantiations: The actions are given as a numbered series.
The actions are given as a counted list.

units.source_excerpt: Our proposal consists of: 1. Increasing irrigation efficiency 2. Importing 10 million tonnes of crops
units.reusable_pattern: Set the plan out as a numbered list.
prohibited_generalizations: do not bury the actions in prose

units.rhetorical_move: closes on the cost of success

units.reusable_pattern: End on what the plan will cost, with ultimately.
prohibited_generalizations: do not end on the benefit alone
